items.program_name: HBI 投資助成(Hoosier Business Investment)(IN)
items.summary: インディアナ州IEDCのHBI助成で、Elkhartの製造業者Flexible Concepts, Inc.に$100kを支給。予定投資額$4.0M(実績$4.99M)、新規雇用40人。

Contract amount $100,000; expected investment $4,000,000; actual investment to date $4,991,459; jobs at contract end 40; base jobs 116; paid to date $100,000; compliant True.

items.program_name: EDGE 税額控除(雇用創出)(IN)
